title: Scatter Paint Tools for Gaffer v0.1.0
content: The first packaged Linux release is live. You only need one download for all three plugins. What Gets Released release file: scatter-paint-tools-gaffer-v0.1.0-linux-gaffer-1.6.18.0.tar.gz included plugins: Scatter Paint, Scatter Plus, and PointCloud Plus setup note: the archive also includes how-to-setup.md What It Is For This release is meant to be the easy install path for artists and TDs who just want the plugins loaded into Gaffer without digging through separate builds. Download GitHub releases: https://github.com/recomblacksmith/scatter-paint-tools-gaffer/releases Current Notes Linux package is ready now. Windows packaging will be added later. The docs on this site now focus on install and plugin use instead of build-system details.
